scripts.script:
-- Check for table that is shared between executions.
if not shared then
	return warn("No shared, no script.")
end

-- Detach previous instance.
if shared.SilentAim then
	shared.SilentAim.detach()
end

local SilentAim = {
	enabled = true,
	showFov = true,
	showHighlight = true,
	fovRadius = 200,
	targetPart = "Head",
	highlightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
	target = nil,

	espEnabled = true,
	espBoxes = true,
	espNames = true,
	espHealth = true,
	espChams = true,
	espNonEnemies = false,
	espMaxDistance = 1500,
	teamColors = {
		Police = Color3.fromRGB(60, 140, 255),
		Prisoner = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 40),
		Fugitive = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50),
	},
	defaultTeamColor = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220),
}

-- Constants.
local GUN_MODULE_NAME = "GunClient"

-- Services.
local playersService = game:GetService("Players")
local userInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local runService = game:GetService("RunService")

local localPlayer = playersService.LocalPlayer
local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- State.
local connections = {}
local espObjects = {}
local espFailed = {}
local espErrorLogged = false
local alive = true
local oldIndex = nil
local currentPart = nil
local rayfield = nil
local hiddenUi = gethui()
local fovCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
local targetHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

fovCircle.NumSides = 64
fovCircle.Thickness = 1
fovCircle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
fovCircle.Transparency = 1

targetHighlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
targetHighlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
targetHighlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
targetHighlight.Enabled = false
targetHighlight.Parent = hiddenUi

---Mirror the game's damage rules. Never call game code, it strips our capabilities.
---@param attackerTeam Team?
---@param victimTeam Team?
---@return boolean
local function canDamageTeam(attackerTeam, victimTeam)
	local attackerName = attackerTeam and attackerTeam.Name
	local victimName = victimTeam and victimTeam.Name

	if attackerName == "NoTeam" or victimName == "NoTeam" then
		return false
	end

	if attackerName == "Police" then
		return victimName ~= "Police"
	end

	if attackerName == "Prisoner" or attackerName == "Fugitive" then
		return victimName == "Police"
	end

	return true
end

---Get the color for a player's team.
---@param player Player
---@return Color3
local function getTeamColor(player)
	local team = player.Team
	if not team then
		return SilentAim.defaultTeamColor
	end

	return SilentAim.teamColors[team.Name] or team.TeamColor.Color
end

---Find the closest damageable enemy part to the cursor inside the FOV.
---@return BasePart?
local function getTargetPart()
	local closestPart, closestDistance = nil, SilentAim.fovRadius
	local mousePosition = userInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	local localTeam = localPlayer.Team

	for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
		if player == localPlayer then continue end
		if not canDamageTeam(localTeam, player.Team) then continue end

		local character = player.Character
		if not character then continue end

		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local part = character:FindFirstChild(SilentAim.targetPart)
		if not (humanoid and part and humanoid.Health > 0) then continue end

		local screenPosition, onScreen = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
		if not onScreen then continue end

		local distance = (Vector2.new(screenPosition.X, screenPosition.Y) - mousePosition).Magnitude
		if distance < closestDistance then
			closestDistance = distance
			closestPart = part
		end
	end

	return closestPart
end

---Create the chams and drawings for a player. Chams first so a parent failure leaks nothing.
---@param player Player
local function createEsp(player)
	local chams = Instance.new("Highlight")
	chams.FillTransparency = 0.75
	chams.OutlineTransparency = 0.3
	chams.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	chams.Enabled = false
	chams.Parent = hiddenUi

	local box = Drawing.new("Square")
	box.Thickness = 1
	box.Filled = false
	box.Transparency = 1

	local name = Drawing.new("Text")
	name.Size = 13
	name.Center = true
	name.Outline = true
	name.Transparency = 1

	local healthBar = Drawing.new("Line")
	healthBar.Thickness = 2
	healthBar.Transparency = 1

	espObjects[player] = { box = box, name = name, healthBar = healthBar, chams = chams }
end

---Hide every ESP element for a player.
---@param esp table
local function hideEsp(esp)
	esp.box.Visible = false
	esp.name.Visible = false
	esp.healthBar.Visible = false
	esp.chams.Enabled = false
	esp.chams.Adornee = nil
end

---Destroy a player's ESP.
---@param player Player
local function destroyEsp(player)
	espFailed[player] = nil

	local esp = espObjects[player]
	if not esp then return end

	espObjects[player] = nil
	esp.box:Remove()
	esp.name:Remove()
	esp.healthBar:Remove()
	esp.chams:Destroy()
end

---Update a player's ESP for this frame.
---@param player Player
---@param esp table
local function updateEsp(player, esp)
	if not SilentAim.espEnabled then
		return hideEsp(esp)
	end

	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not (humanoid and root and humanoid.Health > 0) then
		return hideEsp(esp)
	end

	if not SilentAim.espNonEnemies and not canDamageTeam(localPlayer.Team, player.Team) then
		return hideEsp(esp)
	end

	local distance = (currentCamera.CFrame.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
	if distance > SilentAim.espMaxDistance then
		return hideEsp(esp)
	end

	local rootScreen, onScreen = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
	if not onScreen then
		return hideEsp(esp)
	end

	local color = getTeamColor(player)
	local topScreen = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
	local bottomScreen = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0))
	local height = math.abs(topScreen.Y - bottomScreen.Y)
	local width = height / 1.8
	local left = rootScreen.X - width / 2

	esp.box.Visible = SilentAim.espBoxes
	esp.box.Color = color
	esp.box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
	esp.box.Position = Vector2.new(left, topScreen.Y)

	esp.name.Visible = SilentAim.espNames
	esp.name.Color = color
	esp.name.Text = string.format("%s [%dm]", player.Name, math.floor(distance))
	esp.name.Position = Vector2.new(rootScreen.X, topScreen.Y - 16)

	local healthRatio = math.clamp(humanoid.Health / math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
	esp.healthBar.Visible = SilentAim.espHealth
	esp.healthBar.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0), healthRatio)
	esp.healthBar.From = Vector2.new(left - 4, topScreen.Y + height)
	esp.healthBar.To = Vector2.new(left - 4, topScreen.Y + height - height * healthRatio)

	esp.chams.Enabled = SilentAim.espChams
	esp.chams.Adornee = character
	esp.chams.FillColor = color
	esp.chams.OutlineColor = color
end

---Detach the hooks, drawings and menu.
function SilentAim.detach()
	alive = false

	if oldIndex then
		hookmetamethod(game, "__index", oldIndex)
		oldIndex = nil
	end

	for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end

	for player in pairs(espObjects) do
		destroyEsp(player)
	end

	fovCircle:Remove()
	targetHighlight:Destroy()

	if rayfield then
		rayfield:Destroy()
	end

	shared.SilentAim = nil
end

---Build the Rayfield menu.
local function createMenu()
	local response = request({ Url = "https://sirius.menu/rayfield", Method = "GET" })
	rayfield = loadstring(response.Body)()

	local window = rayfield:CreateWindow({
		Name = "Riot City",
		LoadingTitle = "Silent Aim + ESP",
		LoadingSubtitle = "Riot City",
		ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
		KeySystem = false,
	})

	local aimTab = window:CreateTab("Aim", 4483362458)

	aimTab:CreateToggle({
		Name = "Silent Aim",
		CurrentValue = SilentAim.enabled,
		Callback = function(value) SilentAim.enabled = value end,
	})

	aimTab:CreateKeybind({
		Name = "Toggle Keybind",
		CurrentKeybind = "P",
		HoldToInteract = false,
		Callback = function() SilentAim.enabled = not SilentAim.enabled end,
	})

	aimTab:CreateDropdown({
		Name = "Target Part",
		Options = { "Head", "HumanoidRootPart", "UpperTorso", "Torso" },
		CurrentOption = { SilentAim.targetPart },
		MultipleOptions = false,
		Callback = function(options) SilentAim.targetPart = options[1] end,
	})

	aimTab:CreateSlider({
		Name = "FOV Radius",
		Range = { 50, 800 },
		Increment = 10,
		CurrentValue = SilentAim.fovRadius,
		Callback = function(value) SilentAim.fovRadius = value end,
	})

	aimTab:CreateToggle({
		Name = "Show FOV Circle",
		CurrentValue = SilentAim.showFov,
		Callback = function(value) SilentAim.showFov = value end,
	})

	aimTab:CreateToggle({
		Name = "Highlight Target",
		CurrentValue = SilentAim.showHighlight,
		Callback = function(value) SilentAim.showHighlight = value end,
	})

	aimTab:CreateColorPicker({
		Name = "Target Highlight Color",
		Color = SilentAim.highlightColor,
		Callback = function(value) SilentAim.highlightColor = value end,
	})

	local espTab = window:CreateTab("ESP", 4483362458)

	espTab:CreateToggle({
		Name = "ESP",
		CurrentValue = SilentAim.espEnabled,
		Callback = function(value) SilentAim.espEnabled = value end,
	})

	espTab:CreateToggle({
		Name = "Boxes",
		CurrentValue = SilentAim.espBoxes,
		Callback = function(value) SilentAim.espBoxes = value end,
	})

	espTab:CreateToggle({
		Name = "Names + Distance",
		CurrentValue = SilentAim.espNames,
		Callback = function(value) SilentAim.espNames = value end,
	})

	espTab:CreateToggle({
		Name = "Health Bar",
		CurrentValue = SilentAim.espHealth,
		Callback = function(value) SilentAim.espHealth = value end,
	})

	espTab:CreateToggle({
		Name = "Chams",
		CurrentValue = SilentAim.espChams,
		Callback = function(value) SilentAim.espChams = value end,
	})

	espTab:CreateToggle({
		Name = "Show Non-Enemies",
		CurrentValue = SilentAim.espNonEnemies,
		Callback = function(value) SilentAim.espNonEnemies = value end,
	})

	espTab:CreateSlider({
		Name = "Max Distance",
		Range = { 100, 3000 },
		Increment = 50,
		CurrentValue = SilentAim.espMaxDistance,
		Callback = function(value) SilentAim.espMaxDistance = value end,
	})

	local colorsTab = window:CreateTab("Team Colors", 4483362458)

	for _, teamName in ipairs({ "Police", "Prisoner", "Fugitive" }) do
		colorsTab:CreateColorPicker({
			Name = teamName,
			Color = SilentAim.teamColors[teamName],
			Callback = function(value) SilentAim.teamColors[teamName] = value end,
		})
	end
end

---Hook Mouse.Hit reads coming from the gun module and run the ESP.
local function init()
	oldIndex = hookmetamethod(game, "__index", newcclosure(function(self, key)
		if key ~= "Hit" or checkcaller() or not SilentAim.enabled or not currentPart then
			return oldIndex(self, key)
		end

		-- Only the gun module should see the spoofed value.
		local callingScript = getcallingscript()
		if not callingScript or callingScript.Name ~= GUN_MODULE_NAME then
			return oldIndex(self, key)
		end

		return CFrame.new(currentPart.Position)
	end))

	table.insert(connections, playersService.PlayerRemoving:Connect(destroyEsp))

	-- Create objects off the render thread, failures are logged once per player.
	task.spawn(function()
		while alive do
			for _, player in ipairs(playersService:GetPlayers()) do
				if player == localPlayer or espObjects[player] or espFailed[player] then continue end

				local success, err = pcall(createEsp, player)
				if not success then
					espFailed[player] = true
					warn("ESP create failed:", player.Name, err)
				end
			end

			task.wait(0.25)
		end
	end)

	table.insert(connections, runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		fovCircle.Radius = SilentAim.fovRadius
		fovCircle.Position = userInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		fovCircle.Visible = SilentAim.enabled and SilentAim.showFov

		currentPart = SilentAim.enabled and getTargetPart() or nil
		SilentAim.target = currentPart

		if currentPart and SilentAim.showHighlight then
			targetHighlight.Adornee = currentPart.Parent
			targetHighlight.FillColor = SilentAim.highlightColor
			targetHighlight.OutlineColor = SilentAim.highlightColor
			targetHighlight.Enabled = true
		else
			targetHighlight.Enabled = false
			targetHighlight.Adornee = nil
		end

		for player, esp in pairs(espObjects) do
			local success, err = pcall(updateEsp, player, esp)
			if not success and not espErrorLogged then
				espErrorLogged = true
				warn("ESP update failed:", err)
			end
		end
	end))
end

---Handle init errors.
---@param error string
local function onInitError(error)
	warn("Failed to init.")
	warn(error)
	warn(debug.traceback())
	SilentAim.detach()
end

shared.SilentAim = SilentAim
xpcall(init, onInitError)
xpcall(createMenu, function(error) warn("Menu failed:", error) end)

--[[
    Advanced Team ESP Script for Roblox
    Features:

    - Game verification (Afghanistan only)
    - PC/Laptop only restriction

-- Configuration

local TEAM_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)     -- Green for team
local ENEMY_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)    -- Red for enemies
local FILL_TRANSPARENCY = 0.5
local OUTLINE_TRANSPARENCY = 1

-- Game Verification
local ALLOWED_PLACE_ID = 9679014784 -- Afghanistan game ID

-- Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Verify game and device
local function verifyAccess()
    -- Check if it's the Afghanistan game
    local placeId = game.PlaceId
    
    if placeId ~= ALLOWED_PLACE_ID then
        LocalPlayer:Kick("Wrong game, only for Afghanistan")
        return false
    end
    
    -- Check if on PC/Laptop (not mobile/tablet)
    local userInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    
    -- Check if touch is enabled (mobile/tablet)

local function getPlayerTeamColor(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then
        return TEAM_COLOR
    end
    
    -- Try to get team from various systems
    local team = player.Team
    if team then
        if player.Neutral then
            return Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0) -- Yellow for neutral
        end
        
        -- Compare team colors
        local localTeam = LocalPlayer.Team
        if localTeam and team == localTeam then
            return TEAM_COLOR
        else
            return ENEMY_COLOR
        end
    end
    
    -- Fallback: check for TeamService
    local teamService = game:GetService("Teams")
    local localTeam = LocalPlayer.Team
    if localTeam then
        for _, t in ipairs(teamService:GetTeams()) do
            if t == team then
                if t == localTeam then
                    return TEAM_COLOR
                else
                    return ENEMY_COLOR
                end
            end
        end
    end

end

-- Set up ESP for a player's character
local function setupCharacterESP(player, character)
    if not player or not character or not ESP_ENABLED then return end
    
    -- Clean up any existing ESP for this player first
    cleanupESP(player)
    
    -- Create Highlight
    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "ESP_Highlight"

    highlight.OutlineTransparency = OUTLINE_TRANSPARENCY

    -- Create health bar

    -- Store instances

        highlight = highlight,
        screenGui = screenGui,
        healthBar = healthBar,
        healthFill = healthFill,
        nameLabel = nameLabel,
        character = character,
        humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"),
        connections = {}
    }
    
    espInstances[player] = espData
    
    -- Create update connection
    local updateConn
    updateConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not ESP_ENABLED then return end
        if not espInstances[player] then return end
        if not espData.character then return end
        if not espData.character.Parent then
            cleanupESP(player)
            return
        end
        
        local rootPart = espData.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = espData.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if rootPart and humanoid then
            local head = espData.character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if head then
                local screenPos, onScreen = workspace.CurrentCamera:WorldToScreenPoint(head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                if onScreen then
                    espData.healthBar.Visible = true
                    espData.healthBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, screenPos.X - 25, 0, screenPos.Y)
                    
                    local healthPercent = humanoid.Health / humanoid.MaxHealth
                    espData.healthFill.Size = UDim2.new(healthPercent, 0, 1, 0)
                    
                    if healthPercent > 0.5 then
                        espData.healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
                    elseif healthPercent > 0.25 then
                        espData.healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
                    else
                        espData.healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                    end
                    
                    espData.nameLabel.Text = player.Name
                else
                    espData.healthBar.Visible = false
                end
            else
                espData.healthBar.Visible = false
            end
        else
            espData.healthBar.Visible = false
        end
    end)
    
    table.insert(espData.connections, updateConn)
    
    -- Clean up when character dies
    if espData.humanoid then
        local diedConn = espData.humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            task.wait(0.1)
            cleanupESP(player)
        end)
        table.insert(espData.connections, diedConn)
    end
    
    -- Clean up when character is removed
    local removedConn = character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
        if not character.Parent then
            task.wait(0.1)
            cleanupESP(player)
        end
    end)
    table.insert(espData.connections, removedConn)
end

-- Create ESP for a player

    charAddedConn = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)

    -- Check if character already exists
    if player.Character then
        task.wait(0.1)
        if ESP_ENABLED then
            setupCharacterESP(player, player.Character)
        end
    end
end

    ESP_ENABLED = not ESP_ENABLED

        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

            end

        -- Clear all stored connections
        for _, connections in pairs(allConnections) do
            for _, conn in ipairs(connections) do
                pcall(function()

                end)
            end
        end
        allConnections = {}
    end
    
    -- Print status

local function IsVisible(Character, Head)
	local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
	local direction = Head.Position - origin

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
		LocalPlayer.Character
	}

	local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)

	if result then
		return result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(Character)
	end

	return false
end

-- ПОИСК ЦЕЛИ
local function GetClosestHead()
	local closestHead = nil
	local shortestDistance = math.huge

	local viewport = Camera.ViewportSize

	-- Такой же центр, как у круга
	local screenCenter = Vector2.new(
		viewport.X / 2,
		viewport.Y / 2 - 35
	)

	for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if Player ~= LocalPlayer and Player.Character then

			local Character = Player.Character
			local Head = Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local Humanoid =
				Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if Head and Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0 then
				local position, onScreen =
					Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Head.Position)

				if onScreen then
					local screenPosition =
						Vector2.new(position.X, position.Y)

					local distance =
						(screenPosition - screenCenter).Magnitude

					local insideFOV = true

					if FOVEnabled then
						insideFOV = distance <= FOV_RADIUS
					end

					if insideFOV then
						local canAim = true

						if WallCheckEnabled then
							canAim = IsVisible(Character, Head)
						end

						if canAim and distance < shortestDistance then
							shortestDistance = distance
							closestHead = Head
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return closestHead
end
